description: Freezes the spectrum IN PLACE over marked time spans: at each marker the current analysis window is captured and held across the span, while the file keeps its original length (static duration verified: 2.023 -> 2.0230, 1.521 -> 1.5209). Pinned to mode 3 (freeze channel amplitudes AND frequencies); modes 1 (amps only) and 2 (frqs only) verified running with distinct outputs (execute()). The datafile holds times with a/b markers: 'aT T2' captures the window at T and holds it until T2 ('a' = freeze AFTER this time); 'T1 bT2' holds the window at T2 across the span before it ('b' = freeze BEFORE). At least one marker is REQUIRED - a plain time list refuses 'ERROR: No flags given in freeze data' (verbatim). Deterministic. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Momentary spectral stasis without changing the timeline: the sound walks along, locks onto one harmonic snapshot for a beat, then resumes - unlike focus hold (which EXPANDS each held window, lengthening the file) or focus step (which grid-freezes everything). Use it to pin a vowel mid-word, hold the bloom of a bell strike through its own decay, or produce glitch-freeze stutters by alternating many short a-spans. The 'b' marker freezes retroactively toward a target: '1.2 b1.5' smears the window at 1.5 back over the preceding 0.3 s, an anticipation effect. Multiple spans are legal in one file as long as all times increase ('ERROR: Time values out of sequence in file ...' otherwise, verbatim).

freezedata.description: Text file of freeze spans (write with write_data_file()). Each span is a time pair; prefix one time with 'a' (use this window for the span AFTER it: 'a0.5 1.0') or 'b' (use this window for the span BEFORE it: '1.2 b1.5'). Times in seconds, strictly increasing across the whole file. Refusals verbatim: no marker anywhere 'ERROR: No flags given in freeze data'; non-increasing times 'ERROR: Time values out of sequence in file <name>.'

examples.description: Hold the 0.5 s spectrum until 1.0 s.
examples.expected_use: First write_data_file('frz.txt', 'a0.5 1.0') - the sound plays normally, locks at 0.5 s, resumes at 1.0 s; total length unchanged.

examples.description: Forward freeze plus a retroactive smear.
examples.expected_use: write_data_file('frz2.txt', 'a0.3 0.8\n1.2 b1.5') - one normal freeze, then the 1.5 s window pulled back across 1.2-1.5 s.

known_issues: The datafile REQUIRES at least one a/b marker - plain 'start end' time pairs are refused ('No flags given in freeze data'), a divergence from the banner's 'times MAY be preceded by' phrasing.
All times across all spans must increase; out-of-sequence data refused verbatim.
Modes 1 (amps) and 2 (frqs) verified running, mutually distinct and distinct from mode 3 - reachable via execute(['focus', 'freeze', '1'|'2', ...]).
wav input refused ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); engine auto-PVOCs.
Deterministic (1.3 s-apart runs byte-identical in the data chunk).
